name: modunexo-modules
description: Modules for the Modunexo platform, each packed as an archive you install with `modules add`.

scripts.pack:inbox: mkdir -p dist && npm --prefix ../"CRM Module" run -s modunexo -- modules pack "$PWD/inbox" --out "$PWD/dist/inbox-$(node -p "require('./inbox/package.json').version").tgz"
